energy_slack.pad_semantics: Physical ground means LANDED_SERVICE only, half-open touchdown/service intervals. Observed-reservation union is a calendar observation, not an attribution to policy.

observation_limits: A single paired frozen fixture/manifest; no cross-scenario or statistical superiority inference.
Predicted objective and actual touchdown counts are distinct.
Nearest observed state timestamps are retained for requested pad samples; no state frame is synthesized.
Emergency waiting duration ends at actual emergency start or at 480 when unresolved; wait is not a feasibility guarantee.
Idle windows describe ground or calendar observations; no cause is assigned.
